main_text.p: ba alterutrum evincunt, nec alia exempla. Lego in Martyrologio, die xiv. Martii, de duobus Monachis, quos Longobardi suspen-dio necaverunt in arbore. In ipsis Longobardorum Legibus, Tit. cap. xiv. Si servus regis Morth fecerit, ita decrevimus ut componatur ipsa persona sicut adpreciatus fuerit : & servus ipse super fossam mortui appendatur, & in eum vindicta detur, & sit caussa finita. Plurium (antiquorum quidem) nunc non memini : & hæc ipsa incerta, nec dijudicaverint litem.

page.notes: Printed page number "205" is set in old-style figures; the running head is in small capitals. Some words in the body are faint or partly obscured by the scan (e.g. "Morth", "dijudicaverint"); the line-initial "ba" begins a fragment carried over from the previous page. Marginal marks on the left and right edges are stains or show-through and are not transcribed.
